name: CorShrink
model_likelihood: Approximately normal Fisher Z sample correlations with pair-specific standard deviations based on matched sample counts.
prior: Zij drawn from shared g in chosen family G; g learned by empirical Bayes.
inference_algorithm: Fit the EB model; take posterior mean Z values; reverse Fisher transformation; apply Higham nearest-positive-definite repair.
estimand: Correlation matrix estimated by inverse-transforming posterior mean Fisher Z values and repairing positive definiteness.
data_input: Pairwise-complete sample correlations from an N by P matrix, with matched sample counts or estimated standard errors.
tunable_settings: Prior family G; prior mode fixed or estimated (default U with mode zero).
